$comment: Sprite generation manifest for DuperDurio. Consumed by tools/gen_sprites.py. Each entry maps to a SPR_* index in sprite_data.h. Frames are generated via Replicate (recraft-v3 / pixel_art), background-removed, trimmed, and downscaled to `store_px` before being packed into the citro2d atlas. Order of `sprites` MUST match the SPR_* numeric defines so the .t3s sub-image indices line up.
style_preamble: single game sprite, centered, full body in frame, side-view 2/3 platformer perspective, modern detailed pixel art, crisp clean pixel clusters, bold readable silhouette, dark 1px outline, rich shading with 3-4 tone ramps, vibrant saturated colors, sci-fi alien planet theme, cohesive cohesive palette of deep purples teal-cyan and warm orange accents, plain flat solid white background, no text, no shadow on ground, no border, no frame
